passages.note: Senate Floor concurrence vote on his own bill; Wiener is in the Ayes.

passages.provision_quote: the Legislature endorses a health care system with unified financing, such as a single-payer health care system, to provide accessible, affordable, equitable, and high-quality health care for all Californians
passages.note: Operative text orders a waiver-framework study, not an enacted program; its stated goal endorses unified/single-payer financing (H16).

rows.reasoning: SB 770 (2023-2024), authored by Wiener and passed with his Aye vote, directs the Secretary to research and develop a waiver framework for a unified health care financing system rather than enacting one, so it is a study-directive under V4.1. Because its text states the outcome it seeks -- 'the Legislature endorses a health care system with unified financing, such as a single-payer health care system' -- per the H16 ruling this is BLANK direction-only (toward rung 1, 'Make healthcare free and available to everyone, fully paid for by the public sector') rather than no-evidence.
